title: 3.6 Ages 16-20
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Recognize, hear and say sixteen to twenty, answer How old are you? and ask how old someone is.
grammar_function: How old are you? I am + number + years old. How old is he/she? Is she sixteen? Yes, she is.
prerequisite: 3.5 ages 11-15 and How old are you?; 3.4 yes/no questions with be.
speaking_outcome: Say sixteen to twenty and answer How old are you? with I am ... years old.
